description: Fix all Critical and High severity backend issues (HF-001, HF-004, HF-009, HF-020, HF-021, HF-022, HF-023, HF-024, HF-031, HF-033, HF-088, HF-092, HF-099, HF-106, HF-114, HF-115)
steps: HF-001: In apps/backend/app/api/v1/auth.py around line 180, replace `hmac.new(edge_secret.encode(), message.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()` with `hmac.HMAC(edge_secret.encode(), message.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()`

HF-004: In apps/backend/app/api/v1/auth.py in the forgot_password handler (the function signature `async def forgot_password(request: ForgotPasswordRequest):`), add a `request: Request` parameter and call `await _check_rate_limit(request, 'forgot_password', 3)` at the start. The function signature needs to become `async def forgot_password(request_body: ForgotPasswordRequest, request: Request):` and the body references to `request.email` become `request_body.email`.

HF-009: In apps/backend/app/api/v1/auth.py in the get_current_user function, change the Redis blacklist check failure from raising HTTPException(503) to logging a warning and allowing the request through (fail-open). Replace the `raise HTTPException(status_code=503, detail='Token validation service unavailable')` with `pass` (just log and continue).

HF-020: In apps/backend/app/services/chat_service.py in the save_chat method, add retry logic with a dead letter fallback. After the initial save fails, retry once, and if that fails too, call store_dead_letter with the user message details.

HF-021: In apps/backend/app/api/webhooks/razorpay.py, change `calculate_next_billing_date()` to return a datetime object instead of an ISO string. Change `return (datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(days=30)).isoformat()` to `return datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(days=30)` and update the return type annotation from `-> str` to `-> datetime`. Import datetime at module level.

HF-022: In apps/backend/app/api/v1/payments.py in the verify_payment function, add `razorpay_subscription_id` to the $set update. Also store `razorpay_order_id` from the request body. Change the update to include: 'razorpay_subscription_id': body.razorpay_order_id (or use a subscription_id if available from the order).

HF-023 + HF-088: In apps/backend/app/api/v1/subscription.py, add a new endpoint `POST /cron/downgrade-expired` protected by a cron secret header check. This endpoint queries users with cancel_at_period_end=True AND current_period_end < now() and downgrades them to free tier. Also in apps/backend/app/api/webhooks/razorpay.py, add handling for the 'subscription.expired' event that downgrades the user.

HF-024: In apps/backend/app/api/v1/payments.py in the create_credit_topup endpoint, store the credits amount in Redis keyed by order_id during order creation. In verify_credit_topup, read credits from Redis first instead of fetching from Razorpay API. Fall back to Razorpay fetch only if Redis lookup fails.

HF-031: In apps/backend/app/models/user.py, fix the index from `('subscription.razorpay_subscription_id', 1)` to `('razorpay_subscription_id', 1)`. Also in apps/backend/app/db/mongo.py in create_indexes(), fix the same index path.

HF-033: In apps/backend/app/api/deps/rate_limit.py, add logic at the start of check_rate_limit to check if the user's last_reset_date is in a previous month. If so, atomically reset monthly_message_count to 0 and update last_reset_date. This requires passing the User object or doing a DB lookup. Alternatively, add this check in apps/backend/app/api/v1/chat.py before the rate limit call.

HF-092: In apps/backend/app/api/v1/subscription.py get_subscription_status endpoint, add a type check for current_period_end: if it is a string (from the old webhook bug), convert it or return it directly instead of calling .isoformat() on it. Use: `user.current_period_end.isoformat() if isinstance(user.current_period_end, datetime) else str(user.current_period_end or '')`

HF-099: In apps/backend/app/api/v1/chat.py, move the user.update $inc of monthly_message_count to BEFORE the LLM call (right after rate limit passes) to prevent race conditions. Or better: remove the MongoDB increment entirely since Redis already tracks the authoritative monthly count via rate_limit.py.

HF-106: In apps/backend/app/config.py, extend validate_production_secrets to also check when APP_ENV is 'staging'. Change the condition from `if self.APP_ENV == 'production':` to `if self.APP_ENV in ('production', 'staging'):`.

HF-114: In apps/backend/app/api/v1/auth.py in the signup handler, mask the email in the log: change `logger.info(f'New user signed up: {request_body.email}')` to `logger.info(f'New user signed up: {request_body.email[:3]}***@{request_body.email.split("@")[1]}')`

HF-115: In apps/backend/app/api/v1/auth.py in the login handler, mask the email in the log: change `logger.info(f'User logged in: {request_body.email}')` to `logger.info(f'User logged in: {request_body.email[:3]}***@{request_body.email.split("@")[1]}')`
acceptance_criteria: All modified Python files pass syntax check (python -c 'import ast; ast.parse(open(file).read())')
hmac.new is replaced with hmac.HMAC in auth.py
Redis blacklist check fails open instead of raising 503
User model index uses correct field path 'razorpay_subscription_id'
Email addresses are masked in log messages
